spans.s:
m. (-क्षुः)
A sort of long grass or reed, (Saccharum spontaneum).
E.
अन् neg. and इक्षु sugar-cane; not it, but it's like.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-णं)
Unuttered, unsaid.
E.
अ neg. निगीर्ण uttered.

mfn. (-हः-हा-क्षं)
Unrestrained, unconfined.
E.
अ neg. निग्रह restraint.

mfn. (-च्छः-च्छा-च्छं)
Undesirous, averse, indifferent: so अनिच्छक.
E.
अन्, and इच्छा wish.

f. (-छा)
Indifference, absence of wish or desire.
E.
अन् neg. इच्छा desire.

mfn. (-छुः-छुः-छु)
1 Disliking, not wishing.
2 Indifferent.
E.
अन् neg. इच्छु who wishes: also अनिच्छक.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
1 Transient, not everlasting.
2 Occasional, incidental.
3 Irregular, unusual.
E.
अ neg. नित्य constant.

f. (-या)
An occasional act of worship, sacrifice for a special purpose.
E.
अनित्य occasional, not constant, and क्रिया rite, also अनित्यकर्म्म, &c.

f. (-ता)
Transient or limited existence: also अनित्यत्व.
E.
ता or त्व added to the last.

m. (-मः)
Arguing by illustration, not by logical rule.
E.
अनित्य unusual, and सम same.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Causeless, groundless.
E.
अ neg. निदान.

mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं)
Awake, sleepless.
E.
अ neg. निद्रा sleep.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Pious, virtuous, free, unreproachable.
E.
अ neg. and निन्दित reproached.

mfn. (-न्द्यः-न्द्या-न्द्य)
Faultless.
E.
अ neg. निन्द्य blamable.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Unskilled, unlearned, not conversant.
E.
अ neg. निपुण clever.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Unproduced, unseized.
2 Unasked.
E.
अ neg. निवद्ध attached.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Unsteady (as the mind), agitated.
2 Tremulous, moving.
E.
अ neg. निभृत held firmly.

m. (-षः)
1 A god.
2 A fish.
3 A person whose eyes are fixed, (as in disease, &c.)
E.
अ neg. and निमिष what twinkles; the eyes being always fixed.

m. (-र्य्यः)
A name of VṚHASPATI.
E.
अनिमिष a deity, and आचार्य्य a teacher; the preceptor of the gods.

m. (-षः)
1 A deity.
2 A fish.
3 A demon.
4 A spirit or ghost.
5 A person whose eyes are fixed. See अनिमिष.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Transitory, perishable.
2

Unrestrained.
3

Undefined, unprescribed.
E.
अ neg. नियत restrained.

m. (-मः)
1 Uncertainty, doubt.
2 Absence of moral or religious obligation.
3 Indecorous or improper conduct.
mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Undetermined, undefined, unprovided for, by any rule or law.
E.
अ neg. नियम fixed observance.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unchecked, unobstructed.
E.
अ neg. निराकृत opposed.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 A spy, a secret emissary.
2 Self willed, ungovernable, headstrong.
3 Unobstructed, unrestrained.
m. (-द्धः)
The son of PRADYUMNA, a form of KĀMA, and husband of UṢĀ.
n. (-द्धं)
The rope for fastening cattle.
E.
अ neg. निरुद्ध restrained.

n. (-थ)
1 The atmosphere, aether.
2 An unobstructed path.
E.
अनिरुद्ध unobstructed, and पथिन् a road.

f. (-नी)
A proper name. See उषा.
E.
अनिरुद्ध, and भाविनी a wife; the wife of ANIRUDDHA.

m. (-यः)
Uncertainty.
E.
अ neg. निर्णय certainty.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unascertained, undetermined.
E.
अ neg. निर्णीत ascertained.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Undecidable, incapable of being decided. अ
E.
neg. निर्णेय decidable.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Unexplained, undefined.
E.
अ neg. निर्दिष्ट explained.

m. (-शः)
Absence of demonstration or direction.
E.
अ neg. निर्दिश instruction.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unascertained, undetermined, undefined.
E.
अ neg. निर्द्धारित defined.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Little, slight, light.
E.
अ neg. निर्भर bulky.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Dirty, foul. अ
E.
neg. निर्म्मल clean.

f. (-ल्या)
A plant, (Medicago esculenta, Rox.) See पृका.
E.
अ not, निर् out from, and माल्य from माला a necklace; not used in garlands.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Not to be mentioned or described, indescribable.
E.
अ neg. निर्वचनीय describable.

m. (-हः)
1 Incoherence, want of connexion or consistency.
2 Want of means of subsistence.
3 Incompleteness.
E.
अ neg. निर्व्वाह connexion.

mfn. (-ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं)
1

Disgusted.
2

Poor, needy.
E.
अ neg. निर्व्विण्ण satisfied.

mfn. (-वित्)
Free from pain or trouble.
E.
अ neg. निर्व्विद what annoys.

Discontented.
2

Unquiet discomposed.
3 Unaccomplished, unfulfilled.
E.
अ neg. निर्व्वृत effected.

Poverty.
2

Discontent.
3

Incompleteness.
E.
अ neg. निर्व्वृति completion.

m. (-लः)
1 Air or wind, considered also as a deity.
2 A subordinate deity, forty-nine of whom form a class, ANILAS or winds.
2 One of another class of demigods or

Vasus.
4

Wind, as one of the humors of the body.
5 Rheumatism, paralysis, or any affection referred to disorder of the wind.
E.
अन to breathe, इलट् aff.
f. (-ली)
The fifteenth Nakṣatra or lunar mansion. See स्वाति.
E.
अनिल and the fem. termination: the wind being the ruling deity of the constellation.

m. (-लः)
Name of HANUMĀN and BHĪMA.
E.
अनिल and अण् patronymic affix; see the next.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Darkish.
m. (-लः)
A black horse.
E.
आङ् diminutive, and नील black or dark blue.

m.
A large tree, (Terminalia belerica.)
E.
अनिल, घ्न what removes, कन् added.

m. (-यः)
Pain and swelling of the eyelids and outer parts of the eye.
E.
अनिल, and पर्य्यय pervasion.

m. (-खः)
A name of fire.
E.
अनिल, and सखि a friend, the friend of the wind.

m. (-जः)
The son of the wind, HANUMAN or BHĪMA.
E.
अनिल, and आत्मज son.

Flatulence.
2

Morbid affection of the wind, rheumatism, &c.
E.
अनिल, and आमय sickness.

mfn. (-शी-शिणी-शि)
Fasting, lit. feeding on the wind.
E.
अनिल, and अशिन् who eats.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unconsidered, inconsiderate, imprudent.
E.
अ neg. निलोचित regarded.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unconsidered, ill judged, undiscriminated.
E.
अ neg. निलोडित revolved.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unchecked, unimpeded, unopposed, unforbidden.
E.
अ neg. निवारित checked.

n. (-शः)
Eternally, eternal, (not employed as an adjective.)
E.
अ neg. and निश from निशा night; having no night or end.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
One who has not a lord or superior.
m. (-शः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
अन neg. ईश lord.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unascertained, not certain.
E.
अ neg. निश्चित ascertained.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Unwished, undesirable, bad, unlucky.
f. (-ष्टा)
A plant, (Sida alba.)
E.
अन् neg. इष्ट wished.

f. (-ष्ठा)
Unsteadfastness, unsteadiness.
E.
अ neg. निष्ठा fixedness.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unskilful, ignorant.
E.
अ neg. निष्णात clever.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Imperfect, incomplete.
E.
अ neg. निष्यन्न completed.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Unprohibited, unforbidden.
E.
अ neg. निषिद्ध prohibited.

mfn. (-र्गः-र्गा-र्गं)
Unnaturally elated or depressed.
E.
अ neg. निसर्ग natural condition.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Unanswered, unrefuted.
2 Not set aside or got over.
E.
अ neg. निस्तीर्ण replied to.

mn. (-कः-कं)
1 An army, forces.
2 War, combat.
E.
अन् to live, and ईकन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-स्थः)
1 An armed or royal guard, a centinel.
2 A warrior, a combatant.
3 The trainer of an elephant, an elephant driver.
4 A mark, a sign, a signal.
5 A military drum.
E.
अनीक battle, and स्थ what stays.

f. (-नी)
1 An army, a host, forces.
2 A certain force; one-tenth of an Akṣauhiṇī, containing two thousand, one hundred and eighty-seven elephants, and as many cars, six thousand, five hundred and sixty-seven horse, and ten thousand, nine hundred and thirty-five foot.
3 A lotus.
E.
अनीक an army, इनि aff.

mfn. (चः-चा-च)
Decent, respectable.
E.
अ neg. नीच low.

mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति)
Not keeping low or improper company.
m. (-र्त्ती)
A faithful lover or husband.
E.
अ neg. नीच low, अनुवर्त्तिन् following.

m. (-र्शी)
A Bauddha saint.
E.
अ neg. नीच low, दर्शिन् who sees.

f. (-तिः)
1 Impropriety, immorality.
2 Impolicy, ill conduct.
E.
अ neg. नाति good conduct.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
Unlike, dissimilar.
E.
अ neg. ईदृश like.

mfn. (रः-रा-रं)
1 Without a superior.
2 Unchecked, uncontrolled.
3 Without power, powerless, unable.
4 Atheist.
E.
अन् neg. ईश्वर a supreme.

f. (-ता)
Absence of a supreme ruler.
E.
ता or त्व added to the last: also अनीश्वरत्वं.

m. (-दी)
An atheist, one who denies a supreme ruler of the universe.
E.
अनीश्वर, and वादिन् who asserts.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Careless, indifferent.
E.
अन् neg. ईहा wish.

f. (-हा)
Indifference, apathy, disinclination.
E.
अन् neg. ईहा wish.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Disagreeable, displeasing, unwished.
n. (-तं)
Displeasure.
E.
अन्, and ईहित desired.

m. (-लिः)
1 A name of the monkey

HANUMĀN.
2

BHĪMA.
E.
अनिल the wind, patronymic affix इञ; HANUMĀN and BHĪMA being the sons of ANILA or the wind.
f. (-ली)
A name of SVĀTI, the fifteenth Nakṣatra or lunar mansion.
E.
अनिल and अण् affix fem. ङीप्; ANILA being the ruling deity of the asterism.

Taken.
2

Brought.
3

Obtained.
E.
आङ् before णी and क्त aff.

ind.
1 Having taken.
2 Having brought.
E.
आङ् before णी and ल्यप् aff.
